title: Québec Mega Trail — 2027 schedule
claims: The 2027 event is listed as 1-4 July 2027, with the note 'Date T.B.A' directly beneath those dates.

QMT135 bib pickup and mandatory gear check run 5-7 p.m. on Friday 2 July 2027 at the Hôtel & spa Le Germain de Charlevoix, the pre-race meeting is at 7:30 p.m. and the start is at 8 p.m. from the hotel's interior courtyard.
QMT135 shuttle boarding is at 4:30 p.m. and departure at 5 p.m. from the Mont-Sainte-Anne main parking lot on Friday 2 July 2027.
The same schedule runs the other races from 2 to 4 July 2027, including QMT50, TransQMT 18 km, QMT80, QMT32, QMT6, QMT25, QMT15, the QMT15 night edition and the QMT1 kids race.
